description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_DomDocument, which is a DOMDocument-based implementation of an XML/RPC generator within the Zend Framework. It provides methods to construct XML documents by opening/closing elements, writing text data, and saving the XML as a string. The class extends a generator abstract class and manages an internal DOMDocument object.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_DomDocument
classes.description: A class implementing XML/RPC document generation using PHP's DOMDocument, allowing creation, modification, and serialization of XML documents specific to Zend Framework's XML RPC component.

methods.name: _openElement
methods.description: Creates a new XML element with the specified name and appends it to the current element.

methods.name: _writeTextData
methods.description: Adds a text node with the provided text to the current XML element.

methods.name: _closeElement
methods.description: Closes the current XML element by moving the current pointer to its parent node.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes and returns the XML document as a string.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the internal DOMDocument object and sets the starting current element.
